title: The Bell Thief's Percentage
story: Vespirel the Sound Siphon coils around the great bronze bell of Highcloister and drinks 35% of every ring, so the warning bell can't reach the farms. Tonight a storm is coming and the bell's full voice carries 80 fields' distance. Mr 6 climbs the rope with chalk in his gauntlet.
question: If Vespirel swallows 35% of the bell's sound and its full ring carries 80 fields, how many fields does the weakened ring carry?
hint: Find 35% of 80 first — that's the stolen part — then subtract it from 80. (Or find 65% straight away.)
victory: Mr 6 announced that 52 fields still fell short of the farthest farm by exactly the length of one shout, so he stood on the parapet and shouted; Vespirel, unable to siphon a knight's lungs, slithered off in defeat.
imagePrompt: A great bronze bell in a stone belfry with a translucent serpent coiled around it drinking ripples of sound, while a numeral-six knight balances on the rope doing chalk math on the wall.
